requirements.text: Allow students to customize their timetable with colour-coding, hiding cancelled classes, and adding study blocks.
Implement automatic notifications for new grades and upcoming deadlines.
Enable students to provide anonymous feedback on modules after the teaching period ends.
Ensure feedback is only accessible to coordinators after grades are submitted.
Allow students to choose their own colours for colour-coding from a predefined palette.
Provide a toggle feature that allows students to hide cancelled classes from their timetable view.
Send grade notifications within minutes of grades being posted.
Send deadline notifications at staggered intervals: one week, three days, and 24 hours before the due date.
Allow students to choose their preferred method of receiving notifications (email, SMS, or in-app).
Ensure the feedback system anonymises responses automatically to protect student identities.
Collect feedback covering content quality, instructor delivery, and resource usefulness.
Use a combination of multiple-choice and open-ended questions for feedback collection.
